---
# we combine the RIVM logo and the actual title in the title argument
title: 'Dummy report COVID-19 in the Netherlands'
date: '`r format(Sys.Date(), "%B %d, %Y")`'
author: "Rijksinstituut voor Volksgezondheid en Milieu - RIVM"
output:
  html_document:
      # here we define the table of content
      toc: true
      toc_float: true
      toc_depth: 4
      # here we define the theme (font and color)
      theme:
        base_font: "Verdana"
        primary: "#ca005d"
params: # NOTE these are standard values, can be changed in render function
  example_variable: ""
---

```{r NL, include = FALSE}
# we use chunk option include=FALSE to hide the code and the result from the output
# Labels and axis etc. in Dutch
Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "nl_NL.UTF-8")#Intentional Syntaxt error here!!!!
```

## Introduction
This is a dummy report. It reports on COVID-19 cases in the period
Find more information about R Markdown and how to create all elements in this template report (and more!)
on the [DARA wiki page](https://gitlab.rivm.nl/dara/wiki/-/wikis/Guide:-R-Markdown-in-report)
about R Markdown.


Note that that we can also add variables through the markdown render:
`r ifelse(params$example_variable == "", "No variable found", params$example_variable)`
